meta.name: vercel-composition-patterns
meta.description: React composition patterns that scale. Use when refactoring components with boolean prop proliferation, building flexible component libraries, or designing reusable APIs. Triggers on tasks involving compound components, render props, context providers, or component architecture. Includes React 19 API changes.

howto.what: Claude 会应用 React 组合模式来重构组件，避免使用大量布尔属性，采用复合组件、提升状态等方式设计可扩展的组件架构。
howto.when: 当用户要求重构布尔属性组件、构建组件库或设计组件 API 等任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我重构这个组件，它有很多布尔属性。
say.note: Claude 会应用组合模式减少布尔属性。

say.text: 为这个按钮组件设计一个灵活的 API。
say.note: Claude 会使用复合组件模式。

say.text: 展示如何用复合组件实现一个 Tab。

howto.what_en: Claude applies React composition patterns to refactor components, avoiding boolean prop proliferation, using compound components, state lifting, and composing internals for scalable architecture.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks to refactor components with many boolean props, build a reusable component library, or design component APIs, including tasks involving compound components, render props, or context.

say_en.text: Refactor this component with many boolean props.
say_en.note: Claude will reduce prop proliferation via composition.

say_en.note: Claude will use compound component pattern.

say_en.text: Show how to implement a Tab with compound components.
